metadata.source: SIMULATED 2026 bank teller-queue slot counts based on four weeks of BCA 2016 observations
metadata.slot_definition: Sequential slots 1–8. Actual clock times have not been verified.
metadata.evaluation_scope: Exploratory chronological holdout from the same simulator; not independent real-bank validation.

metric_definitions.residual: simulated actual count minus predicted count
metric_definitions.median_absolute_residual: median of |actual - predicted| over 528 held-out slot observations
metric_definitions.baseline: median of same-slot counts in training period, evaluated on held-out data
